alkylation_concentration: Samples were then reduced with 5 mM TCEP, alkylated with 10 mM iodoacetamide, and quenched with 5 mM DTT, followed by methanol/chloroform precipitation of 200 μg of protein (11-plex).
alkylation_reagent: Samples were then reduced with 5 mM TCEP, alkylated with 10 mM iodoacetamide, and quenched with 5 mM DTT, followed by methanol/chloroform precipitation of 200 μg of protein (11-plex).
cleavage_agent: Pellets were reconstituted in 200 mM EPPS pH 8.5 and digested overnight with LysC (Wako 129-02541) at 1:100 while shaking at room temperature, followed by digestion with trypsin (Pierce 90305) at 1:100 while shaking at 37 °C.
collision_energy: MS2 scans consisted of collision-induced dissociation, quadrupole ion trap analysis, an AGC of 2 × 104, a normalized collision energy (NCE) of 34, a q-value of 0.25, a maximum injection time of 35 ms, and an isolation window of 0.7 m/z using a Top10 method. MS3 scans were obtained in the Orbitrap at a resolution of 50,000, an NCE of 45%, a maximum injection time of 100 ms, and an AGC setting of 1 × 105.
enrichment_method: Samples were enriched using the Pierce High Select Fe-NTA phosphopeptide enrichment kit (A32992) according to the manufacturer’s specifications, except that elutions were carried out into tubes containing 100 μL of 10% formic acid before rotary evaporation.
fractionation_method: The flow-through fraction was then reconstituted in 5% acetonitrile (ACN) 10 mM ammonium bicarbonate for basic reverse-phase fractionation on an Agilent 300Extend-C18 column (3.5 μm, 4.6 × 250 mm) using an Agilent Infinity 1260 HPLC.
fragmentation_method: MS2 scans consisted of collision-induced dissociation, quadrupole ion trap analysis, an AGC of 2 × 104, a normalized collision energy (NCE) of 34, a q-value of 0.25, a maximum injection time of 35 ms, and an isolation window of 0.7 m/z using a Top10 method.
